name: com.writulos/scribe
description: Generate clean markdown documentation for your code — one file, or up to 20 in one batch.

environmentVariables.name: WRITULOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Writulos Scribe API key, from https://scribe.writulos.com/dashboard/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: WRITULOS_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the run log (writulos.log). Defaults to "docs", relative to the project root.

environmentVariables.name: WRITULOS_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Project root the run log is written under. Defaults to the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: WRITULOS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL, for testing against another deployment. Defaults to https://scribe.writulos.com/api
